captions.detailed: A wall-mounted articulated transfer arm featuring a sturdy rectangular backplate with structural mounting brackets. The mechanical arm consists of dark gray/black outer support brackets and light blue-gray rectangular links connected by horizontal pivot pins. The assembly culminates in a square end plate at the wrist, with the joints designed to rotate along horizontal axes to provide vertical articulation.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a wall-mounted articulated transfer arm. The model should include a thick rectangular wall backplate with structural brackets, two progressively smaller rectangular link arms connected via horizontal pivot knuckles with cylindrical pins, and a square end plate at the wrist.
captions.factory: Construct the base wall plate using a box primitive and attach a shoulder bracket using extruded shapes. Model the first and second links as rectangular extrusions with side ribs, and create the knuckle joints by combining boxes and cylinders for the pivot pins. Assemble the parts using a hierarchical articulation structure with revolute joints defined at each horizontal pivot pin axis.
